title: Meeting notes to action-item list
outcome: Turn a set of meeting notes into a clean list of action items, so nobody has to re-read the notes to know who does what by when.

in: One meeting's notes as plain text in, one action-item list out.
out: Any real names or company data

input.description: A file of synthetic meeting notes.

output.format: Markdown table, rendered by a script from the validated list

fields.name: source
fields.description: The sentence the action came from, quoted, at most 25 words.

quality_rules.text: Every action is backed by a quoted sentence from the notes; nothing invented.
Owner and due date come only from the notes; if missing, say 'unassigned' or 'not stated', never guess.
No duplicates and nothing missed: every commitment in the notes appears exactly once.

good.text: A1 | Send the revised budget to the team | Priya | Friday 31 Oct | 'Priya will send the revised budget by Friday.'

bad.text: A2 | Book the venue | Tom | next week | (no source)
bad.why: The owner and date are guessed, and there's no quoted sentence.

gates.decision: Approve or reject the reviewed list before it is final.
